assignments_cancel_fields.name: assignments_cancel_fields
assignments_cancel_fields.value: "assignments"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("assignments"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

unavailability_kind_fields.name: unavailability_kind_fields
unavailability_kind_fields.value: ("unavailability"."kind" = 'weekly' AND "unavailability"."day_of_week" IS NOT NULL AND "unavailability"."date" IS NULL) OR ("unavailability"."kind" = 'date' AND "unavailability"."date" IS NOT NULL AND "unavailability"."day_of_week" IS NULL)
